rootCauses.issue: Cavalry ignored a requested range and rendered 0-250
rootCauses.cause: frameRangeMode 1 is not custom range in Cavalry 2.7.2
rootCauses.fix: Use frameRangeMode 2 and the inclusive requested end frame

rootCauses.issue: Valid short/full H.264 files failed fps validation
rootCauses.cause: Container average frame rate is duration-derived and can be fractional
rootCauses.fix: Prefer the encoded r_frame_rate and fall back to avg_frame_rate

rootCauses.issue: Ten-frame validation intermittently failed to decode an edge sample
rootCauses.cause: Fast seeking too close to a short H.264 clip boundary
rootCauses.fix: Use a two-frame sample guard for clips of at least ten frames

rootCauses.issue: A cancelled native render left the next render stale or wedged
rootCauses.cause: Host-idle status alone did not prove the native Render Manager was reusable
rootCauses.fix: Perform clean-host recovery after cancellation when a checkpoint exists

rootCauses.issue: Cold QC and post-reopen probes timed out on the 140-layer scene
rootCauses.cause: The generic 15-second bridge deadline was shorter than valid host evaluation
rootCauses.fix: Use bounded 60-second deadlines for frame preview and reopened-scene activation

reopenAndRender.evidence: Every scenePath probe reopened the saved .cv before rendering

intentionalUniformContent.reason: The production fixture intentionally contains flat-colour holds and fades; decode, codec, size, rate, exact count and duration remain mandatory, while the preceding 12-image QC verifies content.
